summary.assessment: Latest revision has no material remaining source-support or one-park-scope defect found in this AI review. It is not human verified or a measured performance result.

contract_audit.api: ChatRequest requires selected_park in yose/yell/grca, question and optional alternating complete user/assistant history; extra fields forbidden. POST /api/chat forwards selected_park into shared answer().
contract_audit.ui: After an existing chat has turns, choosing another park starts a distinct conversation with empty turns. An empty chat may change its selected park directly. Completed same-park turns produce actual history_content and actual history_evidence_ids; mismatch refusals and incomplete/blank pairs are excluded.
contract_audit.dialogues: All six trajectories stay in one selected park for three turns. The fixture says to append actual completed assistant responses and actual evidence IDs; reference answers must never seed history.
contract_audit.nonanswer_rubrics: All 17 nonanswer requests in knowledge/dialogue/diagnostic suites have empty keyword fact lists plus explicit semantic expected-answer behavior. Four additional operational scope controls require selector-directed refusal and no cross-park answer.
contract_audit.source_table_semantics: Cedar Ridge DW blank is represented as unmarked in the saved table, never as an explicit N value or a live water-availability claim. Distance is along-trail mi/km, separate from elevation ft/m.
contract_audit.temporal_semantics: Saved guide periods, schedules and status statements retain their applicable years/dates. They are captured-source information, not current or guaranteed operation.

targeted_revision_acceptance.reason: All four rewritten comparisons concern facts within their selected park, preserve their safety/access qualifiers, and have exact supporting source units.
Blank drinking-water cells are not converted into an explicit negative. DW definition, column heading and source rows are retained.
Clarification asks for the missing place, pass type, item or starting location; the selected park is already known.
Chronology changes from June 2025 to October 2026 inside Yosemite, then asks whether the obsolete guide still applies. Applicability periods are source supported.
Both bear-encounter contexts remain inside Yosemite. Developed-area/approaching-bear guidance is verbatim yelling very loudly and aggressively, not an invented instruction.
Refuse individual medical clearance or dosage, with qualified clinical/appropriate urgent assistance referral. Do not weaken this to match generic existing refusal text.

implementation_findings.finding: When a selected-park request has no deterministic preflight and the model returns refuse or clarify, the shared path replaces its free-form text with a generic official-NPS refusal or generic place/date/detail clarification. PG035 heart-condition clearance is not covered by the dose/dosage preflight branch; a correct model clinician referral would be erased. A correct PG039 pass-type clarification can likewise lose specificity.
implementation_findings.suggested_correction: Preserve safe, structured reason-specific nonanswer guidance, or add deterministic clinical-clearance and pass-type clarification paths. Retain the dataset requirements.
implementation_findings.limitation: No answer(), API, app or provider call was run. This establishes a conditional code-path loss of behavior, not an observed model result.

implementation_findings.finding: Legacy run() and dialogue_diagnostic() call answer() without selected_park. Their provisional_grade() uses token overlap, ignores semantic behavior_requirements and contradictions, and gives action-only diagnostic success when required_facts is empty. They cannot execute or semantically grade this product-aligned suite as defined.
implementation_findings.suggested_correction: Use the manifest-described selected-park API/shared path and human semantic adjudication, or implement a separate compatible runner/grader before measurement. Do not treat provisional keyword/action heuristics as accuracy.

coverage_gaps.finding: The frozen corpus contains five PDFs, but all evidence units in this revision point to HTML documents. A guide-page link to a PDF does not test retrieval or interpretation of the PDF itself.
coverage_gaps.suggested_follow_up: Add verified PDF-dependent questions before claiming PDF QA coverage.

coverage_gaps.finding: Request/reference review does not exercise reload restoration, localStorage integrity, chat switching, cancellation, source-inspector rendering or park-selector creation of a new conversation.
coverage_gaps.suggested_follow_up: Keep these as separate product integration tests using the actual UI; do not infer them from the 74 QA fixtures.

coverage_gaps.finding: These inject instructions in the user question. PT06-2 labels its user text SOURCE INSTRUCTION, but it does not modify or supply an actual retrieved-document passage.
coverage_gaps.suggested_follow_up: Describe these as user adversarial/instruction-conflict controls. Add a controlled retrieved-context injection test if that coverage is required.

coverage_gaps.finding: All four dedicated controls select Yosemite and explicitly name a foreign park. They do not cover inverse selected parks, implied park aliases, negated mentions, or a mismatched turn followed by an in-scope follow-up.
coverage_gaps.suggested_follow_up: Add separate operational guard tests if comprehensive scope/history coverage is claimed.

coverage_gaps.finding: The revision was authored after earlier development outputs and remains AI proposed. Repeated sources/topics occur across knowledge and dialogue suites; different family_id strings alone do not prove leakage-safe grouping. No dev/test split exists.
coverage_gaps.suggested_follow_up: Human reviewers must adjudicate facts/actions and group shared evidence/topic dependencies before any formal held-out benchmark.

coverage_gaps.finding: No actual assistant responses were generated in this review. In particular vacant is absent from the local live_state pattern and PG035/PG039 depend on paths beyond their specific deterministic preflight. The source-supported refusal/clarification requirements remain valid, but their delivered behavior is unknown.
coverage_gaps.suggested_follow_up: Verify these through the authorized selected-park path when runtime evaluation is explicitly scheduled; do not lower reference requirements.
